requirement_decisions: Carried-item display strategy (recommended: render carried item attached to player with a small offset).
Initial item spawn coordinates for chalice/key/sword that remain in-bounds and avoid adversarial sampled pixels (80,105) and (9,9).
Item visual spec (color/shape) and ITEM_SIZE relative to PLAYER_SIZE (recommended: ITEM_SIZE = PLAYER_SIZE).
Carry-one second-touch behavior (recommended: ignore second-item contact while already carrying).
Drop placement and anti-loop policy (recommended: drop at player position and suppress pickup for one frame).
Re-pickup timing after drop (recommended: eligible immediately after overlap is cleared).
Whether initial placement is hand-authored vs. programmatically validated for overlap/wall safety.
